title: lane r2 SE: lifecycle falsifier flags every feature-build commit
description: Lane round 2. Lens: software-engineer (validator: SO). Owner: SO session. Defect: line-83 falsifier lacks the fixing-a-defect qualifier its gate twin carries; every phase-2b layer-build commit is a governed-set commit naming a layer issue, not a finding issue — the check fires on the primary build flow; 'defect' itself undefined. Citations verified: contract:83 vs :66, :81. Proposed: resolved-candidate (falsifier requires an owning tracker issue — layer issue for increment builds, finding issue for fixes; a defect is work owned by a finding issue — linkage-decidable).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: lifecycle falsifier requires an owning tracker issue — layer issue for increment builds, finding issue for fixes; defect defined by linkage (work owned by a finding issue). Feature-build commits no longer flagged. Revision: Finding lifecycle bullet + falsifier.
